source.title: Final Term Examination 2017-2018, Std. VII, Mathematics
source.subject: mathematics
source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper; the embedded text layer is corrupt (broken font encoding), so text was OCR'd and corrected against the page images. Printed session 'Final Term Examination 2017-2018'; examYear taken as the later year. Time printed '2hrs.+15mins. reading time' (stored as 135 minutes in total). Four sections of 20 marks each. Section C is marked [4x5=20] but prints five items (a), (b), (c), (d) and a second '(i)' (apparently (e)); no choice instruction is printed, so the listed marks (85) exceed the maximum.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
